title: Grateful Dead Live at Starlight Theater on 1982-08-03
lineage: [SBD > MC > PCM > DAT > CDR] + [Senn 441's (FOB) > Sony TC-D5 > DAT > CD] > WAV > Vegas 5 (matrix) > WAV > CD Wave > FLAC 16

ai_review.summary: A superb matrix capture of a high‑energy 1982 show that “smokes” from start to finish, with crystal‑clear sound and standout performances of Mississippi Half‑Step > Franklin’s, Cumberland Blues, Let It Grow and Shakedown Street.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised as a beautiful matrix mix – crisp, sweet‑sounding and almost audience‑like – that lets listeners feel the Midwest crowd’s excitement. Musically the concert is described as “on fire,” with Jerry Garcia in top form, tight band interplay, and several highlight moments (Cumberland Blues, Peggy‑O, Let It Grow, Shakedown Street, Althea, Stella Blue, etc.). Overall energy is high and the set flow is lauded for smooth transitions and varied pacing.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently glowing comments about both performance (high‑energy, many standout songs) and recording quality (crisp matrix mix), with only a few moderate reviews.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers repeatedly call the sound “beautiful,” “crisp,” “sweet” and “clean,” noting superb stereo ambience that captures crowd reactions. Some wish it were an audience recording, but overall the matrix mix is considered top‑notch.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Set is praised for seamless transitions—especially the Half‑Step into Franklin's and the flow of second‑set jams—and a balanced mix of rockers, ballads and exploratory pieces.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia is repeatedly described as “on,” delivering flawless licks, storming solos (Cumberland Blues, Cassidy) and a birthday‑night jam streak.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent’s keyboards are highlighted for sounding great in the mix; clean and prominent throughout.
band_member_comments.Drums: Drums are noted as good and solid, though a few reviewers say they don’t fully capture live feel.
